post.summary: Create storage class configuration
post.description:
Creates a new storage class configuration in the NVIDIA Run:ai platform.
This endpoint enables administrators to define storage class behavior and customize their usage settings.

get.summary: Get storage class configuration by id
get.description: Retrieves a specific storage class configuration by its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to view detailed information about the configuration, including its permissions and customization options.

patch.summary: Patch storage class configuration by id
patch.description: Partially updates an existing storage class configuration by its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to modify specific fields, such as permissions, customization values, or attributes, without replacing the entire configuration.

put.summary: Update storage class configuration by id
put.description: Updates an existing storage class configuration by its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fully replace an existing configuration, including permissions and customization settings.

delete.summary: Delete storage class configuration by id
delete.description: Deletes a specific storage class configuration by its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to permanently remove configurations that are no longer needed.

ScopeType.name: scopeType
ScopeType.description: The type of resource we want to filter by.

FilterByCluster.name: clusterId
FilterByCluster.description: Filter using the Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

originFilter.name: origin
originFilter.description: filter by the origin of the resource. by default, we have to list only customer existing resources (to preserve backward compatibility) to list both existing pvc and assets related pvcs use 'all'.

includeAncestors.name: includeAncestors
includeAncestors.description: include resources of both requested scope, and its ancestors. for example, if project scope is requested with includeAncestors=true, department and cluster scoped assets will be included in the response.

includeDescendants.name: includeDescendants
includeDescendants.description: Whether the query should include from all nested layers within the specified scope

ClusterUuid.name: clusterUuid
ClusterUuid.description: The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

secretTypeFilter.name: secretType
secretTypeFilter.description: filter by secret type. supported values - password, access-key, docker-registry.

privateFilter.name: includePrivate
privateFilter.description: include private secrets in the response. if not provided, we list only public secrets.

StorageClassConfigurationFilterBy.name: filterBy
StorageClassConfigurationFilterBy.description: Filter results by a parameter. Use the format field-name operator value. Operators are == Equals, != Not equals, <= Less than or equal, >= Greater than or equal, =@ contains, !@ Does not contains, =^ Starts with and =$ Ends with. Dates are in ISO 8601 timestamp format and available for operators ==, !=, <= and >=.

SortOrder.name: sortOrder
SortOrder.description: Sort results in descending or ascending order.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: The offset of the first item returned in the collection.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

is_default.description: Indicator if the storage class is the default storage class

ReportingClusterId.description: Cluster ID which has sent the resource info

allow_volume_expansion.description: Indicates whether the storage class allows volume expansion

is_default.description: Indicates whether the storage class is the default one

allowVolumeExpansion.description: Indicates whether the storage class allows volume expansion

isDefault.description: Indicates whether the storage class is the default one

AllowedForAssets.description: Determines whether PVC assets can be created using this storage class.

AllowedForWorkloads.description: Allows workloads to include PVCs that use this storage class. When disabled, users cannot (a) include non-existing PVC assets created with this class in asset-based submissions, or (b) attach PVCs with existing=false to workloads using this class.

AllowedForEphemeralVolumes.description: Allows workloads to create ephemeral volumes using this storage class. When disabled, users cannot (a) create PVC assets with autoDelete=true and ephemeral=true, or (b) include PVC instances with isEphemeral=false that use this storage class.

AllowedForPersistentVolumes.description: Allows workloads to create persistent volumes using this storage class. When disabled, users cannot (a) create PVC assets with autoDelete=true and ephemeral=true, or (b) include PVC instances with isEphemeral=false that use this storage class.

AllowDataSharing.description: Allows creation of PVCs using a shared volume.

StorageClassPermissions.description: Defines the access permissions and behavioral rules for this storage class.

PvcAccessModes.description: Default access mode(s) applied to newly created PVCs unless explicitly overridden.

readWriteOnce.description: Mount the volume as read/write by a single node.

readOnlyMany.description: Mount the volume as read-only by many nodes.

readWriteMany.description: Mount the volume as read/write by many nodes.

PvcSupportedAccessModes.description: Defines the access modes supported by the given storage class. These values indicate which access configurations can be used when creating PVCs with this class.

readWriteOnce.description: Indicates whether the readWriteOnce access mode is supported. This mode allows a volume to be mounted as read/write by a single node.

readOnlyMany.description: Indicates whether the readOnlyMany access mode is supported. This mode allows a volume to be mounted as read-only by many nodes.

readWriteMany.description: Indicates whether the readWriteMany access mode is supported. This mode allows a volume to be mounted as read/write by many nodes.

AccessModeCustomization.description: Controls whether PVC access modes are required and what defaults to apply.

required.description: If true, the accessMode field is mandatory when creating a PVC that uses this storage class.

PvcVolumeMode.description: Default volume mode for the PVC. Choose between Filesystem (default) or Block.

VolumeModeCustomization.description: Defines whether the volumeMode field is required when creating PVCs and specifies default and supported modes for the storage class.

required.description: Indicates whether the volumeMode field is mandatory when creating a PVC.

supportedValues.description: Lists which volume modes are supported for this storage class.

filesystem.description: Indicates whether filesystem mode is supported. Filesystem allows the volume to be mounted as a filesystem, enabling the usage of directories and files.

block.description: Indicates whether block mode is supported. Exposes the volume as a block storage, which can be formatted or used by applications directly without a filesystem.

PvcClaimSize.description: Requested size for the PVC. Mandatory when existingPvc is false. Recommended sizes: TB/GB/MB/TIB/GIB/MIB

PvcClaimMinSize.description: Minimum claim size allowed for PVCs created with this storage class. Mandatory when existingPvc = false. Recommended values: TB, GB, MB, TIB, GIB, MIB.

PvcClaimMaxSize.description: Maximum claim size allowed for PVCs created with this storage class. Mandatory when existingPvc = false. Recommended values: TB, GB, MB, TIB, GIB, MIB.

PvcClaimStepSize.description: Defines the incremental step between allowed numeric values (for example, 1, 0.1).

ClaimSizeCustomization.description: Defines the default, supported units, and range constraints for PVC claim sizes. These settings control the requested storage capacity when creating a PVC using this storage class.

supportedUnits.description: Units supported for specifying PVC sizes. Valid values: "MB", "MiB", "GB", "GiB", "TB", "TiB".

PvcAddedAttributeFormat.description: Defines the data type the attribute can accept. Enum: "text" "number" "boolean"

PvcAddedAttribute.description: Attribute that is added to any PVC of a given storage class.

key.description: The annotation key for the PVC. Must comply with Kubernetes naming rules: ≤63 characters, beginning and ending with an alphanumeric character ([A-Za-z0-9]), and may include dashes (-), underscores (_), or dots (.).

format.description: Defines the data type the attribute can accept. Enum: "text" "number" "boolean"

display.description: User-friendly display name for the attribute, shown in the UI.

description.description: A description of the attribute's purpose or expected values.
description.example: The host name of the DNS

placeholder.description: Example or hint text for the attribute's value, displayed as a watermark or help message in the UI.

required.description: Indicates whether this attribute is mandatory.

defaultValue.description: Default value assigned to the attribute when not explicitly provided.

validationRegexp.description: Regular expression used to validate user input for text attributes.

minValue.description: Minimum allowed value for attributes of type number.

maxValue.description: Maximum allowed value for attributes of type number.

step.description: Defines the incremental step between allowed numeric values (for example, 1, 0.1).

validationError.description: Custom validation error message shown if input fails validation. If omitted, a default error message is generated automatically.

AttributesCustomization.description: Defines additional annotation attributes to be applied to PVCs created under this storage class. Each attribute describes an annotation key and its expected value format, display name, and purpose.

StorageClassCustomization.description: Optional UI/policy controls that define defaults and requirements when creating PVCs with this storage class.

StorageClassName.description: The name of the storage class to which the configuration applies.

id.description: The unique identifier of the storage class configuration.

scopeType.description: Currently supported value: 'cluster', which is also the default.

storageClassConfigurations.description: A list of storage class configuration objects. Each object defines the configuration details for a specific storage class.

scopeType.description: the scope type of the configuration.

PvcAttributesToRemove.description: optional list of attributes that you wish to remove

ClusterObjectIssue.description: an issue found while syncing the resource to the cluster

ClusterObjectStatus.description: an object that exists in the cluster with a list of issues found while syncing it to the cluster.
